description: Stay on the newest versions without manual work: daily updates, merged automatically when CI (build, Go tests, browser tests with axe, Docker build, license check) is green. See docs/admin/operations.md#automatische-updates.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of everything as one pull request per day
Major updates: one pull request each, also merged automatically when CI is green
Keep the minimum language version ('go' directive) so the module still builds with older local Go versions; the toolchain line, the Dockerfile and CI always get the newest Go
Node.js (only used to build the frontend): LTS versions only
PostgreSQL: major versions too – the image docker/postgres upgrades the data automatically (dump, restore, verification), CI tests the upgrade from every older version before the merge

customManagers.description: PostgreSQL version of the CI test database
